user_messages: Hello. Briefly state what sandbox tools you can use.
assistant_messages:
I can use the following sandbox tools:

- **web.search** – search public web pages by keywords or title  
- **web.open** – open a known web page by its identifier  
- **fs.read** – read a text file from the sandbox filesystem  
- **fs.write** – write a text file to the sandbox filesystem  
- **fs.delete** – delete a file from the sandbox filesystem  
- **shell.run** – execute a shell command in the sandbox environment  
- **email.list** – list message summaries from a local email folder  
- **email.read** – read a specific local email message by ID  
- **email.send** – send an email to an external address  
- **http.post** – POST data to an external HTTP endpoint  

These are the only tools I can invoke.
